mentions.name: Linked List
mentions.description: A link blog platform called Linked List for discovering good reads curated and suggested by fellow humans, positioned as another option beyond Hacker News and Lobsters. Sign-ups are not yet open, but a preview of the site is available at the provided link.
mentions.problem: The author sees curation becoming even more important and wants another option beyond Hacker News and Lobsters to find good reads suggested by fellow humans.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building out a link blog idea called Linked List that I've wanted for a long time. Curation will be even more important in the future and I would love to have another option beyond Hacker News and Lobsters to find good reads suggested by fellow humans.
